content_excerpt: Convex provides two AI-related components: (1) Convex MCP Server — started via npx convex@latest mcp start, provides tools for AI agents to interact with Convex projects; supports production deployments with a danger flag; secured by CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY to limit access to specific deployments; uses Streamable HTTP transport. Agents support createThread, generateText, and continueThread with automatic message history. Threads persist and are queryable. The agent component has a dedicated GitHub repo (get-convex/agent) with setup and dev commands. Convex's AI docs also cover streaming, debugging, and tracking agent runs.

content_excerpt: Convex's Apr 2, 2026 pricing overhaul: Pro deployments increased from 120 to 300 to support agentic-era workloads (agents, preview environments, experimentation). 'File bandwidth' replaced with 'data egress' at $0.12/GB — nearly 3x cheaper — covering file downloads, action bandwidth, log streams, and deployment backups; all network ingress is now free. 'Vector bandwidth' replaced with 'Search Queries' — a combined GB/searches metric for vector and text search indexes; for most users no change, for heavy text search users possibly up to 25% increase but more predictable. Pro support no longer has 24h target for every ticket — AI-driven triage prioritizes billing/production issues; Enterprise accounts offer paid support plans with 24/7 contractual response times. Business Plan at $2,500/month minimum (month-to-month). Enterprise Plan with custom agreements. Free/Starter/Pro self-serve plans updated; Convex for Startups upgraded. Plan transition began May 2026. Current pricing (2026): Free (free forever, small fixed limits — 5GB search storage, 1GB database I/O, 3,000 search query-GBs, 1GB data egress, up to 6 developers, 40 deployments); Starter ($0 base, pay-as-you-go — 1M function calls, 20 action GB-hours included, then $0.33/additional action GB-hour); Professional ($25/developer/month — 256 concurrent queries, 256 mutations, 512 actions, 256 Node actions, 256 scheduled jobs, 25M function calls, 250 action GB-hours, 50GB database storage, 100GB file storage, 1GB search storage, 50GB database I/O, 50,000 search query-GBs, 50GB egress, log streaming, exception reporting, daily backups, custom domains, email support, streaming data exports, management API, standard audit log, HIPAA/SOC 2 reports, BAA); Business/Enterprise custom contracts with $2,500/mo floor.
